methods.name: dayReport
methods.summary: Gets all the data the botnet tracking database has for a given ASN registered to user account for given date.
methods.description:
Gets all the data the botnet tracking database has for a given ASN registered to
user account for given date. If no date is given, it will return results for the
previous day.
